notes: §1985:XI.2.3.2 prints SELECT file-name-1 ASSIGN TO {implementor-name-1 | literal-1} ... and §1985:XI.2.3.3 SR2 permits only the ASSIGN clause to follow file-name-1; no rule restricts literal-1 (the sequential, relative, indexed and report entries each add SR3, a nonnumeric literal that is no figurative constant) so a figurative constant stands where literal appears (§1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 GRL2.3) and a numeric literal is the generic literal-1 and the format's list is the entry's own. Since kb/Work PB5587 AssignTargetRule.Resolve records the 2023 refusals (the figurative-constant and numeric-literal arms of SR4, COBOL2645, and a list, COBOL2256) on FileModel.EntryShapeFindings and FileControlKeyRules.Screen reports them unless the file is an SD below COBOL-2002, so ASSIGN TO SPACE, ZERO, ALL "X", 123 and "W1" "W2" sort at 85 and the other entries and 2002 on keep both refusals. Clauses beyond ASSIGN are COBOL1900 citing SR2; RequiredClauses makes ASSIGN required (COBOL5701); a doubled ASSIGN (COBOL2423) and a second SELECT (COBOL2634) are refused; DOC-A.1-71 states the 1985 basis. History: this row read PARTIAL (over-rejects) naming kb/Work PB5587, which fixed it.
